name: trolley
description: Full Trolley payouts API: recipients, accounts, batches, payments, offline payments, invoices, balances, verifications, webhooks, partner settings. Read tools by default; money-moving and irreversible writes require confirm.

TROLLEY_ACCESS_KEY.description: Trolley API Access Key (Dashboard > Settings > API Keys). Sandbox and live keys differ.

TROLLEY_SECRET_KEY.description: Trolley API Secret Key, used only to HMAC-sign requests locally.
